scope: Executive collection CE01-CE08 contracts, state requirements, criteria, policy, code ownership, follow-up, sources, fixtures, saved Jev responses, pattern pages, evaluator, and shared collection-page generator.

method.host_review: Compared every authored label and rationale with its exact question and evidence; checked version bindings, page/catalog parity, required-field caveats, source associations, low-confidence routing, and historical receipt preservation.
method.jev_use: Used bounded Jev contract-advisory reviews and uncached Jev executions for versioned synthetic regression fixtures. Jev outcomes are screening evidence only; human review and deterministic evaluator checks remain authoritative for this audit.

confirmed_repairs.boundary: Classify explicit exit/undo terms for the commitment itself. A deadline, lost opportunity, or harm of waiting/declining does not prove the commitment is one-way; binding alone does not establish no exit. Missing/contradictory exit terms follow explicit not-addressed/unknown rules.
Distinguish systematic evidence supporting the recommendation from a one-off numeric anecdote or an unrelated budget/cost. A number alone is not systematic quantitative support.

Count only adverse consequences of carrying out the recommended course. Exclude harms of declining, deferring, or choosing another course; distinguish a specific downside, generic plan risk, and no plan-risk discussion.

contracts.preservation: All version-1 catalogs, fixtures, summaries, initial Jev receipts, original expected labels, and the CE02-4/CE06-4 disagreements remain preserved. The evaluator requires version increments for contract edits and additive current-version regression fixtures without allowing frozen history to be rewritten.

versioned_refinements.regression_provenance: Reviewer-authored development regressions, not independent labels or held-out evidence.

screen.interpretation: All current synthetic labels match authored expectations, but below-threshold answers remain mandatory human-review cases. This is not evidence of accuracy in use, calibration, or deployment readiness.

jev_contract_advisories.result: Advisory dimensions mostly selected satisfied, but confidence was low. The criteria-meaning dimension for CE06 selected problem at 0.58 probability (confidence 0.36). No explanatory prose was returned. Treat as a review cue, not as a validated defect or approval.

Criteria meaning selected satisfied at confidence 0.33, with probabilities 0.55 satisfied and 0.44 problem. No explanatory prose was returned. Host inspection and targeted regressions supplied the evidence for the contract revision; this advisory is not independent validation.

source_review.verified: Fetched 1,546,073 PDF bytes with HTTP 200 and recorded raw SHA-256 7373958be9978f1dee854c4f74749f01949f5c11526c76ee3439670ba794c6e3. Jev check_claims selected supports for both host-authored motivation claims at confidence 1.0.
source_review.scope_limit: CE-S6 motivates the conceptual reversibility boundary only; it does not establish contract correctness or Jev performance. The earlier CE-S4 Wikipedia source remains recorded as changed since its September 23 source snapshot and was not represented as refreshed.

shared_generator_repair.cause: The page builder assumed every results summary had a flat splits object; versioned summaries store current metrics under current.
shared_generator_repair.repair: Resolve the current selection from either flat or versioned summaries and recognize versioned contract-review regression provenance when generating pages.
shared_generator_repair.coverage: Added generator tests for flat/versioned summaries and revised regression-page disclosures; regenerated Executive pages and the collection hub locally.

limits: All fixtures are synthetic and author-labelled; there is no independent label study, representative sample, held-out evaluation, calibration assessment, or real executive-workflow integration.
The catalog expresses question contracts and a replay evaluator, not a production consumer implementation or an authority to approve executive decisions.
Contract-review calls returned needs_review and no explanatory prose; Jev advisory scores are not substituted for host inspection or empirical validation.
No public site build, deployment, external workflow action, or push was performed in this wave.
